code_prompt_defaults.object_description: a cone or square pyramid cut by a plane parallel to its base, with the cross-section marked and the needed dimensions labeled
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract: Return a JSON object with keys "answer" and "annotation".
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract_answer_only: Return a JSON object with key "answer".
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel bounding boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] for the target area cue, the marked cross-section, and the visible measurement label boxes needed for the computation
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_number: set "answer" to the marked cross-section area rounded to one decimal place
